content: Patrick Stewart, best known for his roles in Star Trek and X-Men, has died at age 86. A message posted to Stewart’s Instagram account says the actor died in his Los Angeles home on Wednesday “following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s Disease and Lewy Body Dementia.” Born in 1940 in Mirfield, Yorkshire, England, Stewart began his acting career in theater. He eventually landed the role of Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation, which ran from 1987 to 1994. Stewart returned as the Star Trek captain in subsequent films, including Star Trek: Generations (1994), Star Trek: First Contact (1996), Star Trek: Insurrection (1998), and Star Trek: Nemesis (2002). Stewart also starred as Professor Charles Xavier in several X-Men movies. He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 2010. [Media: https://www.instagram.com/p/DfFxNrvAVwK/?cplk=MXVhc3BuZW1qZmJ3bQ%3D%3D&img_index=3] “His sonorous voice and singular talent will forever be synonymous with indelible performances in every genre,” the message on Instagram says. “He explored the human condition in all its poetic complexity and brought hope not only to the far reaches of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, but into science fiction’s most iconic final frontier aboard the Starship Enterprise.”

chineseContent: 因出演《星际迷航》和《X战警》而闻名的帕特里克·斯图尔特去世，享年 86 岁。斯图尔特的 Instagram 帐户上发布的一条消息称，这位演员于周三在洛杉矶的家中去世，“此前他患有阿尔茨海默病和路易体痴呆症，经历了短暂而令人心酸的旅程”。斯图尔特 1940 年出生于英国约克郡米菲尔德，在戏剧界开始了他的演艺生涯。他最终在 1987 年至 1994 年上映的《星际迷航：下一代》中饰演让-吕克·皮卡德船长。斯图尔特在随后的电影中回归担任星际迷航船长，包括《星际迷航：世代》(1994)、《星际迷航：第一次接触》(1996)、《星际迷航：叛乱》(1998) 和《星际迷航：复仇女神》(2002)。斯图尔特还在多部《X战警》电影中饰演查尔斯·泽维尔教授。 2010 年，他被英国女王伊丽莎白二世封为爵士。 [媒体：https://www.instagram.com/p/DfFxNrvAVwK/?cplk=MXVhc3BuZW1qZmJ3bQ%3D%3D&img_index=3] Instagram 上的消息称：“他洪亮的嗓音和非凡的才华将永远成为各种流派中不可磨灭的表演的代名词。” “他探索了人类处境的诗意复杂性，不仅给漫威电影宇宙的遥远角落带来了希望，也给企业号星舰上科幻小说中最具标志性的最终前沿带来了希望。”
